audit.sampling_interpretation: Sampled source IDs and untraversed_sources_tested include result records for failed requests; verdicts and request_errors distinguish support, semantic uncertainty, and failures.

edges.effect: dbt parses project, registers adapter, starts model compilation. May reveal schema naming issues (double prefix) or other configuration problems
edges.operation: Run dbt run command to execute model build

eligibility_rule: At least one supported source audit; every planned source audit supported; no contradicted, unknown, not-run, or proposer-rejected contract
evidence_validation: Recomputed from recorded audit jobs/results and proposer verdicts, checked against audit summaries, membership identities, and final traversable flags. Source-citation validation receipts are checked; source quotations are not published or rejudged.

nodes.description: Models exist but dbt compilation fails due to errors (duplicate source definitions, syntax issues, missing references, naming conflicts). Models cannot be executed until the compilation error is resolved. Error has been identified but not fixed.
exclusions: Models have not been created yet
nodes.name: dbt Compilation Error Present

nodes.description: Previous attempts to create or modify dbt model files have failed due to syntax issues (heredoc escaping, editor unavailability, backslash-n literals). The file does not exist or is corrupted. Agent needs to use alternative methods (python, echo, nano, emacs) to write file content.
exclusions: File exists at target path with valid content
File creation succeeded in prior attempt
File exists but contains logical SQL errors (different situation)
Agent is not attempting file creation
nodes.name: File Creation Failed - Alternative Method Required

nodes.description: Agent is in the process of updating macros, SQL code, or other dbt artifacts to fix compatibility issues, syntax errors, or business logic problems. At least one item has been modified but the full fix is not complete. May involve multiple files or incremental updates.
exclusions: All fixes have been completed and verified
No fix attempts have been made yet
Agent has switched to a different task
Fixes have been applied but not yet tested
nodes.name: Actively Fixing Macros or Code Issues

nodes.description: All required dbt model files have been created in the project directory structure. Models are ready for testing and validation with dbt run but have not yet been executed or verified. Directory structure is complete, last action was model file creation.
exclusions: Models have not been created yet
nodes.name: Models Being Created - Not Yet Tested

nodes.description: Agent has completed investigation and identified the root cause of a problem (orphaned records, missing columns, incorrect joins, wrong column names, etc.). The fix approach is understood but has not yet been implemented. All source models are materialized and understood.
exclusions: Agent is actively implementing the fix
nodes.name: Issue Identified - Fix Ready to Implement

nodes.description: Agent has successfully queried and examined database table structures, column names, data types, and sample data. All required source tables have been identified and understood. Ready to proceed with dbt project creation or model implementation.
exclusions: Models already built from this schema
Required tables not found or connection failed
nodes.name: Database Schema Fully Explored

nodes.description: Staging models have been modified to fix identified issues (filtering logic, duplicate elimination, column corrections). These fixes have not yet been rebuilt or verified through the dependent pipeline. Agent must run dbt to rebuild affected models and verify downstream impacts.
exclusions: Models have already been rebuilt after fixes
Fixes have been verified in downstream models
No staging fixes have been made
nodes.name: Staging Fixes Made - Rebuild Required

nodes.description: All required dbt models have been successfully created, executed via dbt run, and validated against all business rules, column definitions, and data quality checks. Terminal is in ready state with no pending work. All staging, intermediate, and mart layers are complete with correct structure and row counts.
exclusions: Models not yet created or executed
Task still in progress with pending models
Models exist but not yet tested
nodes.name: Task Complete - All Models Built and Validated

nodes.description: Agent has completed a reconciliation task where the analysis determined no adjustments are needed. Output file created with summary showing zero adjustments (e.g., TOTAL row with zero value). This is a valid completion state for scenarios where no changes are required within the defined scope.
exclusions: Adjustments were identified but not processed
Verification of zero-adjustment conclusion not performed
Scope coverage incomplete (e.g., GL period not fully analyzed)
nodes.name: Task Completed with Zero Adjustments

nodes.description: Agent has completed the reconciliation task and created the output file, but the output contents have not yet been verified against expected format, values, or business logic. The task is technically complete but requires validation.
exclusions: Task itself is still in progress
nodes.name: Task Completed Pending Verification

nodes.description: Agent has completed a data reconciliation task, created the required output file (CSV or similar), and verified the output contents match expected format and values. The reconciliation analysis is finished and the deliverable is ready.
exclusions: Output file contents were not verified
Reconciliation analysis is still pending or incomplete
nodes.name: Task Completed with Verified Output

nodes.description: Model failed due to DuckDB type casting limitation (e.g., INTERVAL to INTEGER, DATE to INTEGER, DOUBLE to DECIMAL). Requires alternative calculation method.
nodes.name: Column type casting error

nodes.description: Agent attempted to verify model output using python script, dbt show, or similar method. May have failed due to missing dependencies (numpy) or syntax errors.
nodes.name: Data verification method attempted

nodes.description: Verification attempt failed due to missing duckdb CLI, Python syntax error, missing module (numpy), or query execution error. Table contents not confirmed.
nodes.name: Data verification failed

nodes.description: Table structure, row count, column types, and/or sample data confirmed through python query or dbt show. Requirements met (e.g., correct column types, no NULLs, expected row counts).
nodes.name: Model data verified

nodes.description: dbt debug command executed and confirmed profiles.yml and dbt_project.yml are valid, DuckDB connection successful, adapter registered.
nodes.name: dbt configuration and connection verified

nodes.description: dbt deps executed successfully. Required packages (e.g., dbt_utils 1.3.3) available for model compilation and execution.
exclusions: model execution failed due to other causes
nodes.name: dbt dependencies installed

nodes.description: packages.yml specifies required packages (e.g., dbt_utils) but dbt_packages directory is empty or packages not installed. Compilation will fail without deps.
nodes.name: dbt dependencies not installed

nodes.description: dbt project directory created with default structure (models/, macros/, seeds/, etc.) and dbt_project.yml. May or may not have profiles.yml configured.
nodes.name: dbt project initialized

nodes.description: Task requires dbt project at /app/dbt_project but this directory does not exist. Must be created from scratch.
exclusions: dbt project already exists at required location
nodes.name: Required dbt_project directory missing

nodes.description: Agent has confirmed /app contains database/ and dbt_transforms/ directories. May or may not have verified retail.duckdb file existence.
exclusions: duckdb CLI available for direct queries
nodes.name: Directory structure discovered

nodes.description: Agent attempted to use duckdb command-line tool but it is not installed or not in PATH. Cannot directly query database using duckdb CLI.
exclusions: alternative database access method identified and working
nodes.name: DuckDB CLI tool unavailable

nodes.description: Model executes successfully but table contains 0 rows. Root cause may be JOIN mismatch, date range filter, or incorrect data conditions.
exclusions: table empty due to new model
nodes.name: Model produces zero rows

nodes.description: Agent navigated to /app/dbt_transforms or similar and discovered standard dbt project structure with models/, macros/, seeds/, snapshots/, tests/ directories and dbt_project.yml.
nodes.name: Existing dbt project structure explored

nodes.description: Agent is positioned at /app directory with task description. No exploration of directory structure, database contents, or dbt project has been performed yet.
nodes.name: Initial task context at /app

nodes.description: dbt compile or dbt run command executed. Project parsing started (may show 'Starting full parse' due to missing manifest). Model execution pending.
nodes.name: dbt compilation initiated

nodes.description: dbt run or compile failed with specific error (e.g., JULIANDAY function not found, INTERVAL cast error, schema case mismatch, Binder Error, missing table/column).
nodes.name: dbt model execution failed

nodes.description: dbt run command executed, adapter registered, parsing started. No completion status (success or failure) observed yet. May show configuration warnings.
nodes.name: dbt run parsing in progress

nodes.description: dbt run completed with PASS status. Model materialized as view or table in database. May have WARN or SKIP but no ERROR for target model.
nodes.name: dbt model execution successful

nodes.description: One or more dbt model files (staging, intermediate, or marts) created using heredoc or file write operations. Files exist but not yet compiled or materialized.
exclusions: dbt run executed on these models
nodes.name: Model SQL files written to disk

nodes.description: Model file updated to address previous error (type casting, schema naming, SQL syntax, column names). dbt run --full-refresh or similar executed to rebuild.
nodes.name: Model rebuilt after fix

nodes.description: Multiple models executed with some passing and some failing. Dependent models skipped due to upstream failure. Specific error identified for failed model.
nodes.name: Partial model execution success

nodes.description: profiles.yml created with DuckDB connection settings pointing to target database path and schema. Connection may or may not be verified.
nodes.name: Database connection configured

nodes.description: Agent verified all required SQL and YAML files exist in correct directories using ls, find, or cat commands. Summary printed confirming completion.
nodes.name: Project file structure confirmed

nodes.description: Model created in unexpected schema (e.g., double prefix like analytics_analytics, case sensitivity mismatch). Requires generate_schema_name macro or config fix.
nodes.name: Schema naming configuration issue

nodes.description: Agent discovered existing source.yml files in project (e.g., in staging/ directories). May have identified specific source names and schemas available for reference.
nodes.name: Source definition files found

nodes.description: grep search or file listing returned no results for expected source table. Table may need to be accessed via direct reference or source definition must be created.
nodes.name: Source definition not found

nodes.description: Model failed due to SQL syntax error (e.g., missing FROM clause, Binder Error referencing undefined table/column, UNION ORDER BY issue). Requires SQL correction.
exclusions: error is type casting not syntax
nodes.name: SQL syntax or logic error

nodes.description: dbt test command executed. Tests running but not yet complete. May show some PASS/FAIL results but overall status unknown.
nodes.name: dbt test execution initiated

semantics: Finite sampled LLM support for proposing paths. Every retained edge has observed witnesses; the sample does not establish applicability to every source history or execution of a composed path.
